stops.title: Asɔre no ho yɛ den?
stops.caption: Mmaeɛ ne nkrataa so dodoɔ.
stops.speech: Asɔre akwahosan de wɔn a wɔba ankasa toto wɔn a wɔwɔ nkrataa so ho, na ɛno yɛ den na ɛho wɔ mfasoɔ sene emu biara.

stops.title: Kenkan nkɔanim no
stops.caption: Ɛkwan a ɛrekɔ na ɛho hia.
stops.speech: Nnawɔtwe baako nka hwee. Nkɔanim a ɛwɔ nnawɔtwe nwɔtwe mu na ɛkyerɛ sɛ biribi reyɛ adwuma anaa.
